exposure: Women with normal labor (no oxytocin augmentation)
Normal labor (with or without oxytocin augmentation)
Prolonged labor (defined by ICD code or partogram)
outcome: Factors contributing to negative birth experience
cohort: 829 women with spontaneous onset of labor, living in a Swedish county
finding: One in five women experienced prolonged labor, and those women had a significantly more negative birth experience compared to women with normal labor.
